There is no such thing as waterproof electronics. There is such a thing as water-resistant electronics, but even that can potentially fail.

Even if they weren't certified, phones had some measure of water resistance even years ago. A little exposure to rain or an accidental cup of water spilled on them probably wouldn't ruin an old smartphone unless you were unlucky. Even being submerged a few feet for an hour might not ruin a device if you're lucky. You should probably never go swimming with your phone regardless of it's technical water resistance rating. But if you're a reasonably careful and logical human, you probably won't have any issue.

However, design tradeoffs always exist...whether or not you wish to pursue them or value one attribute more than another is your business of course, but design tradeoffs are real.
